text:
Ben, Cara, and Dev form a consecutive block. Ann, Gus, Finn, Hana, Ivo, and Elif must all precede Cara, so—including Ben—seven people precede her. Thus Ben is slot 7, Cara slot 8, and Dev slot 9.

The others fill slots 1–6. Finn must precede Hana by at least three slots, with Ivo immediately after Hana. The only arrangement compatible with Elif preceding Ivo, Elif and Gus being two slots apart, and Ann preceding Gus is:

Finn, Elif, Ann, Gus, Hana, Ivo.

This also puts Ann and Ivo exactly three slots apart and satisfies all remaining distance constraints.

SCHEDULE: {"1":"Finn","2":"Elif","3":"Ann","4":"Gus","5":"Hana","6":"Ivo","7":"Ben","8":"Cara","9":"Dev"}
